statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent palpitations in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and guide further management.
The current denial is for missing prior authorization.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The diagnosis codes are R55, I48.0, and R00.2.
